web.scope: All 82 browser captures reviewed as four contact sheets; Today, Consolidation and Factor Paydown also reviewed as original PNGs. All 82 routes and fresh image outputs mechanically validated.
limitations: Synthetic fixture states do not demonstrate live backend behavior, production-data accuracy, provider activation or authorization enforcement.
Unavailable, blocked, stale, unselected and other fixture evidence states are retained as rendered; no current runtime outcome is inferred from a capture.

Normal inner scrolling limits lower content in the initial captured viewport. Contact-sheet review is supplemented by three original-size PNG inspections and does not establish keyboard or assistive-technology behavior.

nativeCatalog.scope: Every original native PNG reviewed directly; registered bodies and current captured states are demonstrated within each viewport.

limitations.observation: Source-registered DashboardPage displays the existing Strategy Operations body.
Shared FundLedgerPage metrics and navigation are visible; distinct page-specific workflow details are not demonstrated within the viewport. Source tab routing is preserved.
Initial loading, awaiting-snapshot, backend-probe or selection state remains visible.
Current offline, circuit-open, unavailable, unsupported or blocked domain/service states remain explicit within the correct registered body.
Host activation, provider or credential status is unavailable; applied setting status is unknown.
Runtime/configuration or unwired-action states remain explicit; successful business actions are not demonstrated.

Some captures retain welcome banners, lower black capture bands, right-edge/lower content clipping, low-contrast secondary text, and empty/default/unselected states. DataShell is settled Demo data in this catalog; Accounting Error ribbons are domain blockers.

nativeManuals.scope: All four original workflows reviewed directly; correct native bodies render current synthetic/offline/unselected states.
limitations: Startup welcome banners reduce several viewports; lower black bands and right/lower clipping remain.
DataShell is settled in overview but Loading/Refreshing in manual-data; ProviderHealth retains loading posture and DataQuality unavailable metrics.
Backfill has empty-symbol validation; DataSources has no selected defaults.
Fund leaves show shared context/navigation and sparse lower details within the clipped viewport.
Trading/strategy preserve no-run/no-selection states; SecurityMaster is unconfigured. Settings shows activation unavailable/applied status unknown and a low-contrast Quick Reference.
